78918762.title: Agatha Pricilla
78918762.extract: Agatha Pricilla (born 30 September 1997) is an Indonesian singer and actress. She rose to prominence as a member of the girl group Blink, formed in 2011.

59087894.title: Eva Celia
59087894.extract: Eva Celia Lesmana, better known as Eva Celia (born 21 September 1992) is an Indonesian actress and singer-songwriter of mixed German-Bugis, Javanese, and Madurese descent. She was born in Jakarta, the daughter of Indonesian jazz musician, Indra Lesmana, and actress Sophia Latjuba.

59050251.title: Gista Putri
59050251.extract: Gista Putri (born in Jakarta, 2 August 1987) is an Indonesian actress and presenter.

76378710.title: Harashta Haifa Zahra
76378710.extract: Harashta Haifa Zahra (Sundanese: ᮠᮛᮞ᮪ᮂᮒ ᮠᮄᮖ ᮐᮠᮁ; born September 5, 2003) is an Indonesian beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss Supranational 2024 and Puteri Indonesia 2024. She is the first Indonesian to win Miss Supranational.

43348358.title: Herfiza Novianti
43348358.extract: Herfiza Harun (née Novianti) is an Indonesian actress and model. She is the wife of actor Ricky Harun and the daughter-in-law of the actress and model Donna Harun.

70908766.title: Irish Bella
70908766.extract: Yris Jetty Dirk de Beule (born (1996-04-23)April 23, 1996), better known professionally as Irish Bella, is an Indonesian actress, model, and singer. She is best known for her roles in the Indonesian films Love in Perth (2010), and Heart 2 Heart (2010), and the soap operas Jawara, Jakarta Love Story, Rajawali, and Binar Bening Berlian.

45281970.title: Jessica Mila
45281970.extract: Jessica Mila Agnesia or better known as Jessica Mila (born in Langsa, Nanggroe Aceh Darussalam, Indonesia on August 3, 1992) is an actress and model of mixed Dutch, Minahasan and Javanese descent.

59476390.title: Juliana Moechtar
59476390.extract: Juliana Moechtar (born 1 May 1989) is an Indonesian film actress and model. She began her career as a model in 2005 before pursuing her career in acting.

53672075.title: Karina Nadila
53672075.extract: Karina Nadila Niab (born August 21, 1992) is an Indonesian actress, commercial model, television host, beauty-preneur and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Puteri Indonesia Pariwisata 2017 at the Puteri Indonesia 2017 beauty pageant, and represented Indonesia at the Miss Supranational 2017 pageant.

76994066.title: Ketut Permata Juliastrid
76994066.extract: Ketut Permata Juliastrid Sari is an Indonesian beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss Cosmo 2024. She had previously won Puteri Indonesia Pariwisata 2024.

79599470.title: Luyanda Zwane
79599470.extract: Luyanda Zwane (born 7 February 2004) is a South African actress, influencer and model. She is well known for her starring roles in the Mzansi Wethu telenovela Sibongile & The Dlaminis as Sibongile Mbambo and the drama series Shaka Ilembe as Vundlazi.

78438841.title: Manon Bannerman
78438841.extract: Meret Manon Sarpong Bannerman (born June 26, 2002), also known mononymously as Manon, is a Swiss singer. She began her career through her social media presence on Instagram and TikTok.

39483769.title: Marisa Sartika Maladewi
39483769.extract: Marisa Sartika Maladewi (born 28 June 1993 in Yogyakarta) is an Indonesian model and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Puteri Indonesia Lingkungan 2013, She represented Indonesia at the Miss International 2013 beauty pageant and ended up winning the "Miss Beauty With Voice" and "Best National Costume" awards.

77079732.title: Melati Tedja
77079732.extract: Melati Tedja (Chinese: 特賈; pinyin: Tè jiǎ; born 7 July 1999) is an Indonesian beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Puteri Indonesia Pendidikan & Kebudayaan 2024. She was selected to represent Indonesia at the Miss Charm 2024 pageant held in Vietnam.

50905135.title: Nabila Syakieb
50905135.extract: Nabila Syakieb (born November 18, 1985) is an Indonesian actress and model. Her modeling career began in 1999 when she became a finalist in the Indonesian teen beauty pageant Gadis Sampul.

45447287.title: Pevita Pearce
45447287.extract: Pevita Cleo Eileen Pearce (born 6 October 1992) is a British-Indonesian actress and model of mixed Welsh and Banjar descent.

47878360.title: Prilly Latuconsina
47878360.extract: Prilly Mahatei Latuconsina (born 15 October 1996) is an Indonesian actress, host, and singer. She is known for her leading roles in the television dramas Hanya Kamu, Monyet Cantik 2, and Ganteng Ganteng Serigala.

39366727.title: Raisa (singer)
39366727.extract: Raisa Andriana (born 6 June 1990), better known by her mononym Raisa, is an Indonesian singer and songwriter. She became publicly known for her song titled "Serba Salah".

76121549.title: Saba (singer)
76121549.extract: Anna Saba Lykke Oehlenschlæger (born 11 August 1997), known simply by her birth name Saba (stylised in all caps), is an Ethiopian-Danish singer, musical theatre actress and model. She represented Denmark in the Eurovision Song Contest 2024 with the song "Sand".

76921852.title: Sophie Kirana
76921852.extract: Sophie Kirana (born August 5, 2000) is an Indonesian beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned as Puteri Indonesia Lingkungan 2024. She represented Indonesia at Miss International 2024 held in Tokyo, Japan, and finished as the fourth runner-up.
